findings.evidence: Line 93 is `public section` (no `@[expose]`, unlike `Tensors/Basic.lean:79` `@[expose] public section`); grep shows no `pWit_def`/`pWit'_def` in the file.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem pWit_def : pWit = ((3, 0, 0) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := (rfl)` and `pWit'_def` likewise.
findings.issue: `pWit` (241) and `pWit'` (244) are public defs in a plain `public section` (93, no `@[expose]`), so their bodies are not part of the public interface, and the file supplies no `_def`/component lemma. Every in-file proof unfolds them (`norm_num [pWit, pWit']`, 248/253/257/265/281/287), which no consumer can do. Contrast `Tensors/Basic.lean:1043` `@[simp] lemma kWit_p : kWit.p = ((1,0,0) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := rfl` and `Meson/Basic.lean:325` `@[simp] theorem piPlus_charge : piPlus.charge = 1 := (rfl)`, both in modules using the same pattern.

findings.evidence: Lines 246-248 state only the equality; `HasFormFactor` at 296-297 requires `g p p = m2` and `g p' p' = m2`; no lemma in the file gives a numerical value of `gWit pWit pWit`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem gWit_pWit : gWit pWit pWit = 9 := by norm_num [pWit]` and `gWit_pWit' : gWit pWit' pWit' = 9`, keeping `gWit_pWit_self_eq` as the derived corollary.
findings.issue: `gWit_pWit_self_eq` only states `gWit pWit pWit = gWit pWit' pWit'` and never gives the value `9`, so the mass-shell hypotheses `g p p = m2`, `g p' p' = m2` of `HasFormFactor` (296) cannot be discharged at the witness transition by any consumer: the one public fact about the witness masses is an equality with no value, and the bodies are unexposed (same cause as the previous finding).

findings.evidence: Line 44 text vs. the statement at 173-175 (`∃ a b : ℝ, J = a • p + b • p'`) and 186-188 (`∃ A B : ℝ, J = A • (p + p') + B • (p' - p)`).
findings.issue: The module docstring attributes the sum/difference decomposition to `FormFactor.IsCovariant.exists_eq_smul_add_smul`, but that lemma (173) yields `J = a • p + b • p'`; the sum/difference form is `IsCovariant.exists_eq_smul_add_add_smul_sub` (186). The overview thus points users at the wrong entry point.

summary: The witness momenta `pWit`/`pWit'` are public defs with unexposed bodies and no restatement or value lemmas, so no downstream module can compute with them or discharge the mass-shell hypothesis of `HasFormFactor` at the witness transition; the module docstring also names the wrong lemma for the sum/difference decomposition.
